Facilities Committee - Meeting Minutes, 14 May

Attendees: J. Okafor (chair), L. Marsh, R. Tanaka, S. Ibrahim. The committee reviewed the proposal to relocate the bicycle storage area from the north car park to the courtyard beside Building C.

L. Marsh reported that the courtyard location would add 40 secure spaces and reduce theft, which rose by 15 percent last year. R. Tanaka raised concerns about emergency access and asked for confirmation from the fire safety officer.

The committee agreed to request a fire safety review before any decision, and to collect staff feedback through a two-week survey. The estimated cost of the relocation is 18,000 pounds.

Next meeting: 11 June. Action: S. Ibrahim to circulate the staff survey by 21 May.
